answer.summary: All 8 failures are in graph-interactions.spec.ts, which the change does not touch, and 6 of 8 have no flake history. The shared helper's assertion at line 127 fails because the browser logged a Content-Security-Policy Report-Only violation (missing 'unsafe-eval') from the frontend schemas bundle. That error is deterministic, so a re-run will likely fail the same way. The log is truncated for the other seven failures, so the root cause is not fully confirmed.
